door.aim: Point at the QR. Nothing to tap.

camera.denied: We can't get at the camera. Allow it in your browser settings, or check people in by name.
camera.missing: This device has no camera. Check people in by name.
camera.failed: The camera would not start. Check people in by name.

door.searchName: Type and they appear. Three letters is enough.
door.nobodyExpected: Nobody has signed up or come in yet.
door.noMatch: No name like that. Try the surname. If they are not there, have them ask to join and approve it tomorrow.
door.undone: Taken back. {{nombre}} is no longer in.
door.undoneQueued: Out of the queue. This check-in had not been sent yet.
door.undoFailed: That could not be undone. Try again; if it stays like this, {{nombre}} is still checked in.
door.pointsLede: Tick whoever helped and tap the reason. Two taps and done.
door.nobodyHere: Nobody has come in yet. Points go to people who are already here.
door.pointsUndo: Points land straight away. If you get it wrong you can take them off from that person’s profile.
door.rosterRefused: The list came back empty, which is what happens when you no longer have access. Sign in again, and if it stays like this ask somebody on the committee.
door.pointsUnavailable: We could not read what each reason is worth. Without that the points would be wrong.

invited.title: You're invited
invited.lede: Somebody in the group sent you the link. Sign in with your Google account and you are one of us. No new password.
invited.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. The invitation is what grants access, and the committee can cut it off if it leaks.

open.title: Ask to join
open.lede: You got here without an invitation. Sign in with Google and the committee will let you in by hand, usually the same day.
open.reassurance: From the account we take only your name, your email and your photo. Until you are approved you can see the events, but you cannot sign up for them.

invite.label: Invitation
invite.stale: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one in the group, or come in anyway and wait for the junta to approve you.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.lede: We sent it to {{email}}. If it isn't there, check spam.
sent.link: Tap the link in the email and you're in.
sent.orCode: Or, if you prefer, type the six-digit code in that same email.
sent.linkOpensSafari: The link opens Safari, and from there you would not end up in here. Type the code and it works first time.

errors.sendFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.badCode: That code is not right, or it has expired. Ask for another.
errors.googleFailed: We could not reach Google. Please try again in a moment.

entry.stranded: It looks like you signed in but the session stayed in the browser rather than here. Open the app from Safari, or tell the committee and we will sort it out.
entry.emailFallback: Or, if Google is not working for you, sign in with your email.

errors.generic: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't get through. Check your signal and try again.
errors.offline: You need to be online for this.
errors.forbidden: That one isn't yours to do.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a row. Give it a couple of minutes.
errors.behindServer: This is not on the server yet: the app was deployed ahead of the database. If you are on the committee, push the migrations; if not, tell them.

event.fullNoQueue: Nobody is waiting yet. Join the list and you are first if somebody drops out.
event.fullWithQueue_one: {{count}} person is waiting. People always drop out.
event.fullWithQueue_other: {{count}} are waiting. People always drop out.

ask.title: Coming? Say so now, even if it is a maybe
ask.full: No places left. You can join the waiting list
ask.yesWarning: If you say yes, your face goes on the list above and everybody sees it.
ask.yesPublic: Your face is on the list above.
ask.privateAnswer: Maybes and can't-makes go to the committee only.
ask.queuePrivate: Being on the list does not show anywhere. Only the committee sees it.
ask.queueWarning: Joining the list does not show anywhere. If a place frees up, the committee will tell you.
ask.confirmTitle: Want to come? The committee hands out the places
ask.requestWarning: Asking is not having. The committee decides, and we tell you in the group.
ask.requestedPrivate: Nobody can see that you asked. Only the committee.

queue.onList: You are on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the committee will tell you.
queue.position: You are {{position}} on the waiting list. If somebody drops out, the committee will tell you.

gone.title: Nothing here
gone.body: This event is gone, or you cannot see it yet. Go back and see what is on.

said.yesSub: Change it whenever you like, but say so early: the committee is counting on you.
said.maybe: You said maybe. We are holding your place.
said.maybeSub: If it turns out you can’t, say so and the place goes to someone else.
said.noSub: If you change your mind, come back while there are places left.
said.nothing: You have not said anything yet.
said.nothingSub: Three taps and you are done. Maybe counts too.
said.requested: You have asked. The committee still has to confirm it.
said.requestedSub: Do not buy tickets yet. We will tell you in the group once it is decided.
said.refusedSub: There were more people than beds. Ask again if anything changes.

event.lastOneSub: This will not last half an hour.

gimcana.title: The gymkhana
gimcana.none: This event does not have one.
gimcana.closed: Nothing shows until the party starts. It closes when the party ends.
gimcana.gone: That challenge is not there any more.
gimcana.juntaLooking: the junta is looking at it
gimcana.tryAgain: That one did not count. Have another go.
gimcana.rule: Anybody on the team can do any challenge. One challenge, one photo: the first one that counts, scores.
gimcana.boardLead_one: It moves when the junta approves. Right now there is {{count}} photo in the queue.
gimcana.boardLead_other: It moves when the junta approves. Right now there are {{count}} photos in the queue.
gimcana.boardLeadEmpty: It moves when the junta approves.
gimcana.boardEmpty: Nothing approved yet. The first photos are already in the queue: this will move shortly.
gimcana.boardNote: The scoreboard is for tonight only: it does not touch the course ranking. If the winning team gets something, you decide that at the party.
gimcana.takePhoto: Take the photo or pick one from your camera roll
gimcana.sendNote: Somebody on the junta looks at it the same night. The points land when they say it counts.
gimcana.offlineNote: It works with no signal too: it is saved and sent by itself when the network comes back.
gimcana.queued: Saved. It will send itself when the network comes back — you can close the app.

rejected.title: That one did not count
rejected.noReason: You can send another photo: the challenge is still open.

pick.title: Who are you playing with?
pick.lead: Pick a team. You can change it until you send something.
pick.full: That team is full. Pick another one.

rank.nudge: Nobody above you is slowing down.

recap.title: Last time
recap.were_one: {{count}} was there and we still laugh about it
recap.were_other: {{count}} of us were there and we still laugh about it

upcoming.title: What else is coming
upcoming.thatIsAll: And after that, nothing yet. Relax, something will turn up.
upcoming.none: Nothing else on the calendar yet. Relax, something will turn up.

empty.title: Nothing right now
empty.body: There is nothing on the calendar. Relax, something will turn up.

waiting.banner: You are still on the waiting list. You can see what is coming, but you cannot sign up until the committee lets you in.

inside.lede: The ones who checked in. Each from their own phone on arrival, or with the scanner when the phone could not.
inside.ledePast: The ones the scanner let in at the door.
inside.note: The faces are a sample. The number in the middle is the real count.

checkin.title: Are you there?
checkin.lede: Check in from right here. It looks at where you are, and if you are at the place, that is it: nobody has to scan anything.
checkin.doneNoPoints: Checked in. You already had tonight’s points.
checkin.far: You are {{metres}} m from the place. If you really are there, it is the GPS: try stepping outside for a moment, or tell the junta and they will add you by hand.
checkin.closed: Check-in is not open yet, or it is over.
checkin.noPlace: This event has no place on the map yet. Tell the junta and they will set it in a moment.
checkin.gone: This event is not there any more.
checkin.queued: No signal. We wrote it down with the time and the place you are at now, and it will go on its own when the network comes back.
checkin.pendingOffline_one: {{count}} check-in saved, it will go when the connection is back
checkin.pendingOffline_other: {{count}} check-ins saved, they will go when the connection is back
checkin.photoNote: Optional, and only you and the junta see it. Take it and you get the diptych with the one on the way out.

nofix.denied: You are not letting us see where you are. Your browser settings can give this page location permission, or tell the junta and they will add you by hand.
nofix.unavailable: The phone cannot work out where it is. Stepping outside for a moment or turning the GPS on usually fixes it.
nofix.timeout: That took too long. Try again.
nofix.unsupported: This browser cannot tell where you are. Tell the junta and they will add you by hand.

failed.lluny: The check-in from {{dia}} could not be validated: you were {{metres}} m from the place. No points were added.
failed.tancat: The check-in from {{dia}} could not be validated: it arrived outside the window. No points were added.
failed.noHiEs: The check-in from {{dia}} could not be validated: you were not on the list. No points were added.
failed.senseLloc: The check-in from {{dia}} could not be validated: the event had no place set. No points were added.

exitPhoto.noFrame: The camera has not given a picture yet. Give it a second and try again.
exitPhoto.entryAlt: The photo from when you came in

entrada.title: However you are arriving
entrada.note: Only you and the junta see this one, and they use it to work out who came in. Take the one on the way out too and you get the diptych.

sortida.title: However you are right now
sortida.note: Nobody else sees this photo. Not the junta, not the group, not the ranking: it goes in your profile and the diptych is yours to look at.

camera.denied: We cannot open the camera. Give it permission in your browser settings, or leave it: the photo is optional and you are already checked in.
camera.missing: This device has no camera. You are checked in all the same; the photo is what you miss.
camera.failed: The camera would not start. Try again, or leave it: you are already checked in.

diptych.title: Your nights
diptych.worseOut: You come out worse than you went in. That is the whole point.
diptych.stillTime: Still time: you can take it whenever, two weeks from now included. Different jumper, same idea.
diptych.takeExit: Take the one on the way out
diptych.nobodyElse: Nobody else sees these two photos: not the junta, not the group. If you share it, you share it.
diptych.forgetExit: Delete the one on the way out
diptych.noNights: You have not checked in at a door yet. When you do, the night shows up here.

neither.title: No photos from that night
neither.body: The junta had the door camera off that day, and you never took the one on the way out. You were there all the same.
neither.nextTime: Next time you can take the way-out one even without the door one: the diptych then shows your arrival time instead of the picture.

diptych.staysHere: This button stays for good, even a fortnight later. The card on the home screen goes away; this one does not.

exitCard.title: The way out is missing
exitCard.body: You took the arrival one at {{titol}}. The way-out one is yours to take now, and the diptych is yours alone.
exitCard.bodyWithTime: You checked in at {{titol}} at {{hora}}. The way-out one is yours to take, and the diptych is yours alone.

share.failed: The card could not be made
share.nothingAuto: Nothing gets posted on its own. You decide, every time.
share.downloadNote: This phone cannot share images from the browser. It is in your photos and you post it.

gallery.title: The photos
gallery.whoCanUpload: Anybody who checked in that night can add photos.
gallery.thumbsNote: These are all thumbnails. The full-size one loads only when you open it.
gallery.uploadNote: They go one at a time and the thumbnail is made right here before uploading. Keep the screen open until it finishes; anything that fails stays here.

empty.title: No photos from this night yet
empty.yours: You were there. The first one is yours if you want it.
empty.theirs: They come from whoever checked in. When there are some, you will see them here.

report.title: What is wrong with this photo?
report.hi_surto: I am in it and I do not want to be
report.no_es_d_aquella_nit: It is not from this night
report.note: The junta sees it and takes it down if needed. Whoever added it will not know you asked.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.lede: What to do on the days when nothing is on. The committee looks at whichever has most votes.
ideas.mineLede: Only you see this. Nobody else knows yours was turned down.
ideas.privateNote: A turned-down idea is on nobody else's list. Not even the title.
ideas.withdrawNote: You can delete it while nobody has backed it.
ideas.emptyTitle: Nothing here yet. Go on, say it
ideas.emptyLede: If nobody says anything, nothing happens: that is what the weeks between events do.
ideas.emptyPick: Start with one of these, if you like
ideas.emptyPickNote: Tap one and it goes in the title. You can change it after.
ideas.emptyFoot: It does not have to be good: people will vote. And if it goes ahead, {{points}} for whoever said it.
ideas.loadingNote: The propose button waits for nothing: you can tap it straight away.
ideas.failed: The ideas could not be read
ideas.failedSub: We do not know how many there are. That is not the same as none.
ideas.failedVotesSub: We do not know what you had backed either. Nothing is touched until it loads.
ideas.newLede: Two things and that is it. We can talk about the details later.
ideas.newBodyPlaceholder: Where, when and what is needed. Four words will do.
ideas.newPublic: It goes up with your name and your face, and everybody in the committee can vote for it.
ideas.newPaid: If the committee turns it into an event, {{points}} for you.
ideas.juntaLede: The same list everybody sees, with two more buttons.
ideas.whyNotPlaceholder: Whoever proposed it will read this, and nobody else.
ideas.whyYes: Why yes, if you want to say
ideas.noEvents: An event has to exist already before an idea can become one.
ideas.alreadyDecided: Somebody else has already decided it.
ideas.whyNotNote: It cannot be turned down without a reason: that sentence is the whole of what the person receives, and it is the difference between them proposing another one and never proposing again.
ideas.queuedOffline_one: {{count}} idea saved, it goes up when there is signal
ideas.queuedOffline_other: {{count}} ideas saved, they go up when there is signal

install.title: Put it on your screen
install.lede: Two taps and it behaves like a real app. Without it there are no alerts when places open, and they will go to someone else.

step1.title: Tap Share, at the bottom
step1.body: It's the little square with the arrow pointing up, in the middle of the Safari bar.

step2.title: Scroll down to "Add to Home Screen"
step2.body: It's further down the list. Then Add, top right.

payoff.title: What you get
payoff.body: Alerts when places open, your QR without hunting for it, and full screen. In a normal browser tab the alerts never arrive: that's Apple, not us.

install.laterWarning: You can carry on here in the browser. Once you add it to your home screen you'll sign in one more time, because the iPhone treats them as two separate things.
install.iconPreview: This is how it will sit among your apps. The red icon is easy to spot when you are in a hurry.

junta.title: Committee area
junta.newEventSub: Or copy an earlier one and change the date
junta.invitesSub: The group code and who wants in
junta.paymentsSub: Mark who has paid and name admins
junta.noEvents: Nothing on the calendar yet. Create the first one.
junta.youAreAdmin: You are an admin: you can create events, check people in, give points and name other admins.
junta.youAreOwner: You are the owner: on top of what an admin does, you can take points away and hand over the owner role.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.oneCode: One code per group, that is all. If it leaks, kill it and make another.
invites.shareText: Join us: {{link}} — the code is {{code}}. Sign in with Google and that is it.
invites.killAndRemake: Kill this code and make another
invites.killExplains: Anybody already in stays in. It only stops working for new people.
invites.none: There is no active code right now. Nobody can get in by invitation.
invites.askFirst: If you do not know the name, ask the group before letting them in. Better to take a day than to have strangers in the ranking.
invites.letInDone: {{name}} is in. They can join with the code.
invites.rejectDone: {{name}} does not get in. They are not told anything.

payments.title: Payments and committee
payments.bizum: The money still moves the way it always has. This is only so nobody ends up keeping a spreadsheet on their phone.
payments.nobody: Nobody has signed up yet. They appear here once they say yes.
payments.chaseThem: Anyone still unpaid on Friday morning, message them yourself. The group chat does not work.
payments.handover: When you hand over in June, name the next lot before you go. Otherwise nobody can create anything next year.
payments.adminCan: An admin can create events, check people in and award points. Have three or four, not one.
payments.queueSub: In the order they joined. If a place frees up, you decide who takes it.
payments.requestsSub: Nobody has one until you say yes. Anybody you do not confirm stays waiting — that is not the same as being told no.
payments.noRoomLeft: No places left. Raise the cap on the event form if you want to fit one more.
payments.gone: That person is no longer asking.

form.coverEmpty: Tap to add the cover photo
form.coverHint: Landscape, with people in it. That is what makes people tap through.
form.name: What it is called
form.what: What kind of thing it is
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What there will be, who is playing, what to bring
form.transportHint: Always write this. It is the question the group asks most.
form.transportPlaceholder: The last train, the night bus, who is driving
form.revealSub: Publish it covered: until the time you set, people see the teaser and the countdown.
form.teaserHint: Enough to intrigue and no more. Explain it and there is nothing left to reveal.
form.teaserPlaceholder: Keep the weekend of the 14th free
form.previewNoDate: Set a time and it opens by itself
form.previewHiddenFields: The place, the description, the cover and getting home: hidden until then.
form.publishNow: It appears on everyone's Home straight away.
form.publishHidden: It opens by itself at the time you set. Nothing else to do.
form.saveChangesNote: It is already on everyone's Home: the change shows straight away.
form.liveSub_one: {{count}} person can see it right now.
form.liveSub_other: {{count}} people can see it right now.
form.liveSubPlain: Everybody can see it right now.
form.draftSub: Nobody but you can see it.
form.unpublishAsk: Unpublish it and it disappears from everyone’s Home. Anyone already signed up stays signed up.
form.deleteAsk: Sure? It goes for good, along with everyone who signed up. This cannot be undone.
form.deleteHasPoints: This one has points on it and cannot be deleted: the points would be left with nothing to say where they came from. Unpublish it and it disappears from everyone’s Home.
form.previewLive: This is what the association will see
form.previewCovered: This is what they will see until it opens
form.confirmHint: Tick this and signing up becomes asking: nobody has a place until the committee confirms it, one by one. Ticked by default for a country house.
form.confirmOn: The committee decides who gets in
form.confirmOff: Signing up gives you a place straight away
form.carsHint: Tick this and the shared-cars block appears on the event. Ticked by default for a country house; untick it if people can walk.

periods.title: The ranking periods
periods.lede: Where one term ends the next begins, so there is only one date between any two. They save together: if one is wrong, none of them is saved.
periods.outOfOrder: The dates have to run from first to last, and none can be missing.

scale.title: The scale
scale.lede: Motives are the buttons on the awarding screen. Types only pre-fill a new event and never restate one that already exists.
scale.cantAdd: Adding a new one cannot be done from here: it also needs a change in the database, and a row on its own would be a button that fails when somebody presses it.

graus.title: The degrees
graus.lede: The list people pick from. Rename one and everybody who already picked it changes too.
graus.name: Degree name
graus.removeSure: Sure? Anybody already on it keeps it; it just stops being offered.
graus.rowSub: In case the university opens a new one

members.title: Members
members.signOutSure: They stop seeing events and drop out of the ranking. Points and attendance stay exactly where they are; this deletes nothing.
members.lede: Who has left, who is back. Signing somebody out deletes nothing: they stop getting into the app and what they did still counts in the history.
members.rowSub: {{count}} people. Sign out whoever has left

audit.title: The log
audit.lede: Who did what, and when. It answers who appointed an admin, and what the association holds about somebody who asks.

accio.set_published: {{actor}} changed whether an event is visible
accio.delete_grau: {{actor}} took a degree off the list

home.doorHint: If somebody is not on the list, you can find them by name from the scanner.
home.doorNoneSub: Nothing on for now. The scanner turns up here the day before.
home.doorFailed: The door could not be read
home.doorFailedSub: We do not know whether anything is on. That is not the same as nothing being on.
home.doorFailedNote: The scanner saves what you check in and uploads it when the connection is back.
home.workNoneSub: Nobody is waiting to be approved, everybody has paid and there are no drafts.
home.workFailed: We could not count what is left to do
home.pending_one: is waiting to be let in
home.pending_other: are waiting to be let in
home.pendingSub: While they wait they cannot sign up for anything
home.waiting_one: is waiting on an answer for {{event}}
home.waiting_other: are waiting on an answer for {{event}}
home.waitingSub: Somebody has to say whether they are in
home.draftsSub: Work done that is not doing anything yet
home.soonFailed: The calendar could not be read.
home.soonFailedSub: There may be events we cannot see. Do not create anything new until it loads.
home.howSub: Touched once a year, and today only with SQL.
home.proposalsSub: Proposals will carry a number, like the approvals
home.periodsStale: The terms do not cover today
home.periodsOk: When each term starts and ends

dashboard.title: The dashboard
dashboard.rowSub: Who is drifting away, and what to do about it
dashboard.lead: Data since September. It updates itself; nothing to export.

drifting.title: Drifting away
drifting.lead: They came often and have missed the last two events in a row. This is the number this phase exists for.
drifting.was: Came to {{n}} of the {{total}} that counted for them
drifting.action: → Split the list between you: one personal message each. The group chat does not work.

attendance.title: Attendance through the course
attendance.action: → The week after exams, something free and on a Thursday.

types.title: What kind works
types.alwaysFull: Always full, with a waiting list.
types.action: → In January: one party and one weekday activity, not two activities.

schools.title: The three schools
schools.note: Active = came to something in the last 30 days.

points.title: Where the points come from
points.action: → Setting up and driving are easy points to hand out in January: announce them before each plan.

limits.title: Limits and data
limits.years: “Who had been coming for years” cannot be said yet: the data starts in September. The dashboard reads the rhythm within the course.
limits.noTables: No new tables: it is all queries over check-ins, points, profiles and periods.
limits.write: “Message them” opens WhatsApp with the number the junta already sees. Nothing is sent automatically.

gimcana.lead: It hangs off {{event}}: it opens when the party starts and closes when it ends.

menaSub.escoles: Automatic, nothing to configure and nobody left without a team.
menaSub.junta: You name each team and split people up yourselves.
menaSub.sorteig: One button splits up whoever checked in that night.
menaSub.lliure: You create the teams and everybody joins the one they want.

gimcana.shuffleNote: Splits up whoever checked in. Anybody who arrives later lands in the smallest team when they open it.
gimcana.alreadyPlayed: Challenges have already been approved. Shuffling now would invalidate the scoreboard.
gimcana.provesNote: Challenges that can be photographed, and round numbers. The face of the game: between five and ten.
gimcana.publishNote: Nobody sees it until the party starts. The challenges can be changed until then.
gimcana.queueEmpty: No photos waiting. Come back in a while.
gimcana.whyPlaceholder: If it does not count, say why. Whoever sent it will read this.
gimcana.pace: Counts or does not, and the next one comes up by itself. At two a minute, a night’s queue is five minutes between you.

photos.title: Reported photos
photos.rowSub: The ones somebody asked you to look at
photos.empty: None. Nobody has asked you to look at anything.
photos.note: Taking it down hides it from everybody at once, and it can be undone. Whoever reported it appears nowhere; whoever added it only sees that it has gone.

geo.hint: Type it and pick it from the list: that way people read it and can also check in. With no point on the map, only the scanner is left.
geo.noPoint: No point yet. Pick a result, press "I am here", or paste the coordinates.
geo.noFix: We could not work out where you are. Pick a search result or paste the coordinates.
geo.pasteHint: For when the search cannot find the place: copy them from anywhere and put them here.
geo.radiusNote: Fifty metres for a bar, three hundred for a farmhouse. Each phone’s own GPS margin is added to the radius, or people standing in the room would fall outside it.

checkins.title: Who checked in
checkins.lede: Points are granted on check-in. This is for taking them back when needed, not for granting them: look at the metres, and whoever checked in from far away stands out.

onboarding.title: You're in
onboarding.lede: Four things and you are in. We already have your name and photo from Google — check they look right.
onboarding.nameHint: Use the name people call you here, not the one on your ID.

school.label: Your school
school.lede: Your points go to your school. The three of them compete all year.

degree.label: Degree
degree.listFailed: We could not load the list of degrees. Carry on and add it later from your profile.

phone.label: Phone
phone.why: Only so we can add you to the WhatsApp group. It does not appear on your profile and nobody outside the committee sees it.
phone.invalid: That number does not look right. Leave it blank if you would rather not.

cta.pickSchool: Pick a school and you are in

onboarding.later: You can change all of this later in your profile.

badges.title: Badges
badges.lead: You earn them by doing things, not by asking. Nobody can hand you one.
badges.leadEmpty: None yet, and that is where everybody starts. They all come from turning up: the first one lands on day one.
badges.stripEmpty: None yet. The first one lands the first day you come.
badges.footerGrid: The ones you are missing tell you how they are earned. None counts down, none expires.
badges.footer: A badge you have earned never goes away, even if you stop meeting the condition.

primera.title: The first one
primera.about: The day you walked through a door and it was recorded. No other badge can come before this one.
primera.won: There is a first time now. It stays on your profile.

activitats.title: Five, ten, twenty-five
activitats.done: Events you have turned up to
activitats.about: Events you have turned up to. One badge that levels up: there is no set of three to collect.
activitats.won: One more event that counts. It stays on your profile.

capDeSetmana.title: Weekend away
capDeSetmana.about: A country house is not a night, it is two days with the same people. The only badge that asks you to pack.
capDeSetmana.won: First weekend away. It stays on your profile.

deTot.title: A bit of everything
deTot.about: Party, country house and activity. The comi does three very different things, and this says you have tried all three.
deTot.won: You have done all three kinds of plan. It stays on your profile.

alVolant.title: Behind the wheel
alVolant.about: You offered seats and somebody took them. An empty offered car does not count: what this recognises is having driven people.
alVolant.won: You drove people there. It stays on your profile.

aMuntar.title: Setting up
aMuntar.hint: Come and help set an event up
aMuntar.about: You turned up before anybody else to do the part nobody sees. The junta awards it with the set-up points.
aMuntar.won: You came to set up. It stays on your profile.

copilot.title: Passenger
copilot.about: You rode in somebody else’s car. Car sharing works when both halves show up, and this is the other one.
copilot.won: You shared a car. It stays on your profile.

vaSerIdeaMeva.title: That was my idea
vaSerIdeaMeva.hint: An idea of yours that goes ahead
vaSerIdeaMeva.done: An idea of yours, taken up
vaSerIdeaMeva.about: You suggested something and the junta took it. Of all the badges, this is the one that leaves the most behind.
vaSerIdeaMeva.won: Your idea is going ahead. It stays on your profile.

entradaISortida.title: In and out
entradaISortida.about: The face arriving and the face leaving, from the same party. The diptych is yours and the junta cannot see it.
entradaISortida.won: You have the whole diptych. It stays on your profile.

deLesPrimeres.title: Early on
deLesPrimeres.hint: Check in among the first five one night
deLesPrimeres.done: Among the first five to check in
deLesPrimeres.about: Among the first five to check in, and only at events with ten people or more. Turning up early when it matters.
deLesPrimeres.won: You checked in among the first five. It stays on your profile.

breakdown.title: Where the points came from
breakdown.empty: No points yet. Come to something and this fills itself in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.public: Show me in the public ranking
settings.publicOn: You appear with your name and face.
settings.publicOff: You do not appear, but your points still count for your school.
settings.nightsSub: The in-and-out diptych from every party

streak.title: Your streak

none.label: no streak going
none.sub: It starts at the first one you come to.

streak.note: Only events you could have come to count. A waiting list never breaks it.

broken.title: The streak stopped at {{n}}
broken.body: Those {{n}} stay as your best. The next event starts another one, the same for everybody.

streak.atStake: You are on {{n}} in a row. This one counts.

qr.offlineOk: Brightness up · works with no signal
qr.howTo: The fallback: if you cannot check in from your phone, show this at the door and wait for the "checked in".
qr.unavailable: We cannot show your code right now. Try once with a connection and it will be saved for next time.

notYet.title: No code yet
notYet.pending: Your QR appears once the committee lets you in. Until then you can see what is coming, but the door cannot check you in.
notYet.left: This account is no longer active. If you think that is a mistake, talk to the committee.

ranking.schoolsLede: Everything you do counts for your school, whether you are 3rd or 60th.
ranking.cutOff: That is as far as the list goes. If you cannot see yourself, you need to get out more.
ranking.nothingYet: Nobody has any points yet. The first event gets it started.

rides.title: Lifts
rides.iDrive: I am driving and have seats
rides.drivingPays: Driving is worth {{points}}. It is the only way to score that does not go through the bar.
rides.lede: Whoever wants a lift. You can sort the petrol out between you.
rides.notesPlaceholder: If you smoke in the car, if the boot is full, if you are coming back Sunday afternoon… a few words.
rides.phoneNote: You will see the number of whoever gets in, in case you have to wait five minutes. They do not see yours.
rides.pointsLater: The {{points}} go on when you are back, not now.
rides.onlyOne: One so far. More will turn up, but this one is definitely going.
rides.beFirst: Be first and pick your seat. The other cars appear once there are people: it always goes that way.
rides.emptyLede: If you have a car, say so now: people sign up for the journey before they sign up for the house.
rides.emptyFoot: Driving is worth {{points}}, and you do not have to drink anything to earn them.
rides.emptyNote: Empty means empty: nobody has offered one.
rides.loadingNote: Offering one does not wait: this button already works.
rides.failed: The cars could not be read
rides.failedSub: We do not know whether there are any, or whether you have a seat. Do not stay home over this.
rides.failedKeep: If you already had a seat, you still have it: nobody loses that.
rides.driverPhones: Only you see these numbers, and only for the people in your car. They do not see yours, or each other’s.
rides.nudgeText: It is {{who}} — I am driving to {{event}}: {{when}} from {{from}}.
rides.withdrawSure: If you take it back, the {{count}} of them lose their seats. Tell them in the group yourself, and do it early, not on Friday.
rides.otherCar: You are already in another car going the same way. Get out of that one first.
rides.gone: That car is no longer there.
rides.holdNote: You hold the seat; they take it when they want. Nobody gets in a car because somebody else said so.
rides.inviteNobody: Nobody left to invite: they are either already in a car, or they are you.
rides.yourSeat: A seat is being held for you
rides.yourSeatSub: {{who}} is holding you a seat. Take it if you are going.
rides.invitedOk: Seat held. It is their call now.

scanner.okWalkin: Not on the list, but come on in
scanner.okWalkinReview: Let them in — not signed up and not paid
scanner.alreadyCheckedIn: This QR has already been used
scanner.notAMember: This QR isn't one of ours
scanner.queued: Saved. It will send once there's signal

action.okWalkin: They were not signed up. It is recorded now.
action.okWalkinReview: Check they pay on the way in, or note it down.
action.alreadyCheckedIn: They already came through. If they insist, check the manual list.
action.notAMember: Ask their name and find them by hand. Do not wave them through unrecorded.
action.memberInactive: Have them ask to join. You approve it tomorrow from the junta area.
action.eventNotOpen: Check this is the right event and that it is published.
action.error: Keep scanning. It sends itself when the signal comes back.

state.empty: Nothing right now. Something will turn up
